programme.desc: Explorers in Mexico uncover the ruins of an ancient snake-worshiping civilization. Celebration turns to horror when they awaken an ever-growing anaconda, starved of human sacrifices for centuries. Now, the team must band together to survive.

programme.title: Evil Nanny
programme.desc: A couple hires a live-in nanny, who soon starts showing her neglectfulness. However, the nanny established legal residency in the home, embarking the couple on a legal battle to reclaim their home.

programme.title: Exorcism The Possession Of Gail Bowers
programme.desc: Based on one of the true incidents that inspired THE EXORCIST, a psychiatrist suggests that the parents perform an actual Catholic exorcism on their daughter, who actually believes she is possessed.

programme.title: Alien Siege
programme.desc: After an alien space craft appears above Washington, D.C., a disparate band of residents in a small Connecticut town must fight off a unit of alien soldiers on the hunt for the President of the United States after his escape chopper crash lands nearby.

programme.title: 5-Headed Shark Attack
programme.desc: A beautiful island's aquatic life faces a new terror: the 5-Headed Shark, a demented starfish-shaped monster threatening Puerto Rico's beaches

programme.title: Dracula: The Original Living Vampire
programme.desc: Det. Amelia Van Helsing hunts a killer of young women. All evidence leads to the untouchable Count Dracula.

programme.title: AE Apocalypse Earth
programme.desc: A group of refugees from Earth land on an exotic planet, where they must fight ruthless aliens to survive.

programme.title: King Arthur and the Knights of the Round Table
programme.desc: In this modern retelling of the classic tale, facing certain defeat, Merlin banishes the evil enchantress Morgana and her son Mordred to the ends of universe. Vowing revenge, Morgana and her son return to Earth, hell-bent on destroying every last descendant of King Arthur and his Knights.

programme.title: Battle For Pandora
programme.desc: After a help signal from a research vessel makes it back to Earth, the Space Force sends a rescue ship to Pandora. They discover Pandora is already inhabited by a highly evolved species that won't give up their Earthling prisoners without a fight.

programme.title: All Good Things Must Come to an End
programme.desc: Our Heroes drive through Los Angeles on their way to the mobile CDC lab. They discover the CDC lab isn't just a lab...it's a submarine! Dr. Merch welcomes our Heroes aboard and not a moment too soon as the Zeros show up hot on their heels.

programme.title: Fracking Zombies
programme.desc: In need of gas, the team follows a suspicious stranger to a damaged oil refinery deep inside a New Jersey no-go zone packed with zombies.

programme.title: Ape X Mecha Ape: New World Order
programme.desc: After an attempt on Abraham the giant ape's life, a journalist uncovers a global plot to awaken an ancient creature. Humanity's last hope is an uneasy alliance between Abraham and Mecha Ape MkII to stop the threat and save the Earth.

programme.title: Zunami
programme.desc: When the last surviving cosmonaut crashes to earth, Citizen Z gets a real live buddy, but it quickly becomes clear that his new friend has a secret agenda. Meanwhile, a massive zombie herd forces the team to take refuge in a morgue.

programme.title: Crisis of Faith
programme.desc: Warren's inability to stop the mayhem causes a crisis of faith in the whole group. Surrounded by Zombies in an abandoned church, their faith is restored after encountering a mysterious stranger who turns out to be something much more.

programme.title: Airline Disaster
programme.desc: Domestic terrorists skyjack the world's largest passenger plane on its maiden voyage. When the President is notified that her brother is on board, she must choose between family and the safety of the people in the cities below.

programme.title: Mt. Weather
programme.desc: Warren and Our Heroes must stop Zona from launching operation "Black Rainbow" which will release a flesh eating bacteria to "cleanse" the landscape of zombies -- and humans -- so Zona can repopulate the mainland with their offspring.

programme.title: We Interrupt This Program
programme.desc: Searching for a transmitter to contact Kaya at Northern Lights, Our Heroes discover an abandoned TV NEWS STATION.

programme.title: Ape vs. Mecha Ape
programme.desc: Recognizing the power of its captive giant Ape, the military makes its own battle-ready, Mecha Ape. But its first practical test goes horribly wrong, leaving the military no choice but to release the giant Ape to stop the robot.
Jack and Melissa are frightened by their son's bizarre and violent behavior; they soon learn that he is the gateway to the Apocalypse, and it will happen on his birthday, 11-11-11.

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: Civilization is laid to ruin when a super-race of aliens invade Earth. Massive walkers cover the planet annihilating all in their path as cities crumble.

programme.title: Doc Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
programme.desc: Doc finds himself taken captive by a psychotic nurse and her surviving mental patients in an homage to "One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest" but with Zombies. Doc discovers that 10K is also being held prisoner by the lunatics.

programme.title: Welcome to the Newpocalypse
programme.desc: Warren recovers from the drone crash with handsome, mysterious Cooper; Doc and the others finally arrive in Newmerica, where they meet George, who is helping form the new country.

programme.title: 2010 Moby Dick
programme.desc: A modern adaptation of the classic novel of the captain of a high tech submarine and his obsessive quest to destroy the enormous prehistoric whale that maimed him.

programme.title: 100 Million BC
programme.desc: During the 1940s, government scientist Dr. Frank Reno (Michael Gross) lost a platoon of American soldiers in a botched time-travel experiment. When a rescue team transports the survivors -- including Reno's brother, Erik (Christopher Atkins) -- from prehistoric times to 2008, they unwittingly allow an uninvited guest to follow them. Now, a desperate group of modern Navy SEALs and their World War II-era counterparts must stop a vicious Tyrannosaurus rex from ravaging the streets of Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Ten years after the events of the first film, Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are settled in 1935 London, where they are raising their son. When a chain of events finds the corpse of Imhotep resurrected, the O'Connells go on a desperate race to save the world from unspeakable evil and to rescue their son before it is too late.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Cursed by a devious sorceress, China's ruthless Dragon Emperor (Jet Li) and his vast army lie buried in clay for millennia. When young archaeologist Alex O'Connell is tricked into reviving the emperor, he and his famous parents (Brendan Fraser, Maria Bello) must find a way to send the ghoul back to the grave before he can awaken his vast army and take over the world.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
programme.desc: Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: After Norwegian researchers discover an alien ship buried in the ice, paleontologist Kate Lloyd (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) joins the team at the isolated Arctic outpost to investigate. She finds an organism that appears to have perished in the crash eons ago but, in fact, is about to awake. Freed from its icy prison, the insidious life-form goes on the attack. Paranoia spreads like wildfire among the crew as they fight to survive against a creature that assumes the shapes of its victims.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: The Purge
programme.desc: In an America ravaged by crime and overcrowded prisons, the government sanctions an annual 12-hour period during which all criminal activity -- including murder -- is legal. James Sandin and his family face the ultimate test when an intruder drags the vicious outside world into their home. James, Mary and their two children struggle to survive the night while trying not to turn into monsters like the ones they are striving to avoid.

programme.title: The Purge: Election Year
programme.desc: As a young woman, Sen. Charlie Roan survived the annual night of lawlessness that took the lives of her family members. As a presidential candidate, Roan is determined to end the yearly tradition of bloodlust once and for all. When her opponents hatch a deadly scheme, the senator finds herself trapped on the streets of Washington, D.C., just as the latest Purge gets underway. Now, it's up to Leo Barnes, her head of security, to keep her alive during the next 12 hours of mayhem.

programme.title: Drop Dead Fred
programme.desc: An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Housesitter
programme.desc: Architect Newton Davis (Steve Martin) is distraught when his girlfriend, Becky (Dana Delany), spurns his proposal and refuses to move into the lavish house he designed for her. Davis, who cannot imagine himself living alone in the house, shares his tale of woe with Gwen (Goldie Hawn), a dishonest waitress he thinks doesn't speak English. Complications arise when Davis, on the brink of reconciliation with Becky, discovers that Gwen has moved into the couple's soon-to-be dream home.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: Lariat
programme.desc: An old friend of Lucas's returns to town in the company of a shady gambler and is accused of cheating at cards.

programme.title: Smoke Screen
programme.desc: Several men are vying for a prosperous rancher's daughter's affections. When she is found dead, one of them becomes the prime suspect in her murder.

programme.title: Shotgun Man
programme.desc: Lucas receives a series of mysterious threatening notes from an ex-convict with a grudge.

programme.title: Sins of the Father
programme.desc: After shooting a man in self-defense, Andy Moon turns to Lucas for protection from the man's brothers.

programme.title: The Prodigal
programme.desc: To keep his invalid mother happy, an outlaw forces Lucas and Mark to go along with a masquerade that he is the owner of Lucas's ranch.

programme.title: The Fourflusher
programme.desc: A sharecropper enters his colt in a horse race hoping to win enough money to buy his farm from the owner who has bet on Mark McCain's entry.

programme.title: The Jailbird
programme.desc: When Lucas hires an ex-con as a ranch hand, the man is the first under suspicion when a murder occurs in town.

programme.title: Meeting at Midnight
programme.desc: Lucas helps his former Army captain, now an undercover federal agent, infiltrate a gang of bank robbers.

programme.title: Nora
programme.desc: Lucas finds himself involved in murder when he gallantly steps to the aid of a beautiful woman.

programme.title: The Hangman
programme.desc: An ex-convict is blamed for a brutal crime despite his claims of rehabilitation.

programme.title: Trail of Hate
programme.desc: Lucas is out for vengeance when Mark is used as a pawn in a bank robbery scheme.

programme.title: Woman from Hog Ridge
programme.desc: Lucas shoots a horse thief who turns out to be a member of the Boyle clan. Now Ma Boyle is after him.

programme.title: Seven
programme.desc: Seven condemned murderers escape and take over the town of North Fork.

programme.title: The Pitchman
programme.desc: When Mark finds gold on their property, a fast-talking salesman who tried to sell Lucas a new lightning rod offers instead to buy the ranch's mineral rights.

programme.title: Strange Town
programme.desc: Lucas tracks an escaped prisoner to a town that turns out to be run by the gunman's brother who is notorious for shooting people in the back.

programme.title: Baranca
programme.desc: When an outlaw leader lures Marshall Torrance out of town, Only Lucas can stop him from lynching a local man.

programme.title: The Martinet
programme.desc: A former army captain comes to North Fork to kill the man who shot down his son in a gunfight - Lucas McCain.

programme.title: Miss Milly
programme.desc: A new store owner upsets the town by demanding all credit accounts be paid off.

programme.title: Dead Cold Cash
programme.desc: The widow of a bandit killed by Lucas plots a grotesque revenge.

programme.title: The Schoolmaster
programme.desc: Mark and his friend become trapped in an old mine.

programme.title: The Promoter
programme.desc: A con man makes his living by provoking and then betting on gunfights.

programme.title: The Illustrator
programme.desc: Lucas encourages a drunken artist charged with murder to use his talents to identify the true killer.

programme.title: The Silent Knife
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark try to persuade a persecuted young mute to return stolen money.

programme.title: Miss Bertie
programme.desc: A lively old lady arrives in town hot on the trail of a notorious bandit and the reward money for capturing him.

programme.title: Six Years and a Day
programme.desc: A doctor seeks revenge on the man he blames for ruining his practice.

programme.title: Flowers by the Door
programme.desc: Lucas unmasks a killer posing as a door-to-door seed salesman.

programme.title: Long Trek
programme.desc: Lucas and Marshall Torrance run into trouble while transporting a captured killer back to face trial.

programme.title: The Actress
programme.desc: A deathbed request from an old friend sends Lucas to a neighboring town in search of the man's sweetheart.

programme.title: Face of Yesterday
programme.desc: Lucas thinks he has seen a ghost when a man, eerily similar to a man he killed, challenges him to a gunfight.

programme.title: The Wyoming Story: Part 1
programme.desc: Lucas agrees to take a job as an undercover agent and goes to investigate rumors of the sales of arms to renegade Indians. His life is endangered by the town drunk who stumbles onto his true identity.

programme.title: The Wyoming Story: Part 2
programme.desc: While Lucas is in Wyoming on the trail of a gang illegally selling weapons to the Indians, Mark stays with Miss Milly, where he suffers from loneliness and doubt with his father gone for 2 months.

programme.title: Closer Than a Brother
programme.desc: Lucas looks for answers when recovering alcoholic Micah Torrence returns to the bottle and turns in his badge.

programme.title: The Lost Treasure of Canyon Town
programme.desc: Lucas, Mark and Micah tangle with the Newman family and learn the secret of a town's 20-year-old mystery.

programme.title: Dark Day at North Fork
programme.desc: Blinded in an explosion, Lucas fights despair as he prepares for a meeting with a gun-toting enemy.

programme.title: The Prisoner
programme.desc: A deranged ex-prisoner of war, cruelly abused in a Northern army prison, captures Lucas, locks him in a cage and vows to make him suffer for his part in the Civil War.

programme.title: Assault
programme.desc: A traveling salesman can't talk his way out of an assault charge.

programme.title: Short Rope for a Tall Man
programme.desc: Lucas is threatened with hanging by a lynch party when some horses he has purchased in a neighboring town turn out to be stolen.

programme.title: The Clarence Bibs Story
programme.desc: A janitor-turned-gunfighter's reputation hangs on one lucky shot and a lot of gall. The handyman finds himself in trouble when he accidentally kills another gunfighter.

programme.title: The Score Is Even
programme.desc: Lucas tries to get help when he is shot after witnessing a murder.

programme.title: The Mescalaro Curse
programme.desc: After being foreman of a jury that convicted an Apache, Lucas is marked for death. Now, he must discover who is behind the curse.

programme.title: Stopover
programme.desc: Lucas allows some snowed-in stagecoach passengers to stay with him until the roads are passable. Trouble brews when the whisky salesman and gunfighter fall for the same woman.

programme.title: The Lonesome Bride
programme.desc: Two pranksters write away for a mail-order bride, using Lucas's name.

programme.title: Death Trap
programme.desc: Lucas recognizes Dr. Battle as an ex-gunslinger with whom he once fought. He helps with a dying man, but Lucas and the doctor have unresolved anger.

programme.title: The Queue
programme.desc: A Chinese man and his son fight prejudice as they try to open a laundry in North Fork.

programme.title: The Vaqueros
programme.desc: While Lucas and Mark are traveling across the Mexican desert they encounter a trio of Mexican bandits who demand payment to cross "their" desert.

programme.title: First Wages
programme.desc: Mark takes a job as a stable boy against his father's wishes.

programme.title: Sheer Terror
programme.desc: Mark and Milly are held hostage in her general store when two gunmen attempt a daring robbery.

programme.title: The Stand-In
programme.desc: Two prison wagon drivers stop at the McCain ranch looking for whiskey. Lucas turns them down because they are escorting a murderer, to be hanged in Yuma.

programme.title: The Journey Back
programme.desc: Mark goes to work for Will Temple, a badly scarred, very mysterious rancher.

programme.title: The Decision
programme.desc: Corey Hazlett insists he's innocent of murder, despite Lucas's eyewitness testimony.

programme.title: Knight Errant
programme.desc: Lucas tries to dissuade a latter-day knight from rushing into battle.

programme.title: Honest Abe
programme.desc: Abe Lincoln's claim that he's the Great Emancipator amuses everyone except Matt Yordy.

programme.title: The Long Goodbye
programme.desc: Stubborn Grandpa Fogarty is Lucas's main roadblock as he tries to get young Woody Fogarty to attend school.

programme.title: The Shattered Idol
programme.desc: Mark Twain visits North Fork and quickly alienates the townspeople.

programme.title: Long Gun From Tucson
programme.desc: Lucas tries to stop embittered John Holliver from venting his wrath on the people who expelled him from town years before.

programme.title: The High Country
programme.desc: Lucas becomes the target of a vengeful mountaineer after he is responsible for a young mountain boy's death.

programme.title: A Friend in Need
programme.desc: When Mark is kidnapped and held for ransom, he finds himself an unwilling companion of gunman Carl Avery.

programme.title: Skull
programme.desc: Lucas seeks an escape when he's captured by outlaws while seeking help for an injured Mark.

programme.title: The Princess
programme.desc: The young Queen-to-be of France hides out in North Fork with her sick brother.

programme.title: Gunfire
programme.desc: A notorious killer is being held in the North Fork jail. When word gets around that Gordo's gang is on its way to free him, the whole town becomes frightened.

programme.title: The Quiet Fear
programme.desc: Lucas's old Army pal settles in North Fork with his deaf daughter.

programme.title: Sporting Chance
programme.desc: An Englishman arrives with a custom-made rifle and a plan to kill Lucas.

programme.title: Young Man's Fancy
programme.desc: Mark falls head-over-heels in puppy love.

programme.title: The Man from Salinas
programme.desc: Banker Hamilton is closing up for the day when Rudy Gray persuades him to stay open for one more transaction.

programme.title: Two Ounces of Tin
programme.desc: Tip Corey, the son of a man allegedly murdered in North Fork, has a killer's reputation and comes to town to kill Micah.

programme.title: Deadly Image
programme.desc: Len Richards and his brother, Ab, confront a Lucas McCain look-alike, Earl Bantry and his sidekick K.C. Peters, for slaughtering one of Richards' steers.

programme.title: The Debt
programme.desc: Lucas and Mark stop on the way to the county fair to deliver a message to Micah, who is escorting a prisoner to be hanged. Mark and Lucas recognize the prisoner.

programme.title: Tinhorn
programme.desc: Mark and Milly are shocked when Lucas begins gambling. They don't know that Lucas is "undercover" trying to catch a man cheating.

programme.title: None So Blind
programme.desc: Mark befriends singer-banjoist Lafayette Bly, a blind man with an acute sense of hearing and a very strong grip.

programme.title: Jealous Man
programme.desc: A retired lawman's irrational jealousy threatens not only to destroy his marriage but also to make him an easy target for someone who wants him dead.

programme.title: Guilty Conscience
programme.desc: No one is more surprised than Micah when newcomer Leota Carraway claims he's her long-lost husband and the father of her child.

programme.title: Day of Reckoning
programme.desc: Lucas is torn by conflicting emotions when he meets the town's new preacher, a former outlaw whom the Rifleman vowed to kill.

programme.title: The Day the Town Slept
programme.desc: The town of North Fork becomes a haven for outlaws when suave Ben Judson smooth-talks his way into the marshal's job.

programme.title: Milly's Brother
programme.desc: A handsome gambler moves into town and begins wooing Milly Scott, claiming to have known her deceased brother.

programme.title: Outlaw's Shoes
programme.desc: Lucas develops temporary amnesia from a head injury while visiting a strange town and mistakenly assumes the identity of a wanted criminal.

programme.title: The Executioner
programme.desc: A former neighbor of the McCains' is released from jail after serving his sentence for robbery. Lucas lets the man work for him but the new hand holds a secret.

programme.title: Waste: Part 1
programme.desc: When Lucas, Mark, and Micah get lost in Old Mexico, they are held hostage by a group of bandits who intend to kill the men and take Mark as a slave.

programme.title: Waste: Part 2
programme.desc: While trapped in the ghost town saloon, Lucas tries to come up with a plan to escape with his son and Micah after Mark refuses to leave without him.

programme.title: Lou Mallory
programme.desc: Lou Mallory arrives in North Fork and starts buying up land and businesses. Lou and Lucas start disliking each other after she reveals plans to build a railroad on "worthless" land.

programme.title: Quiet Night, Deadly Night
programme.desc: When a woman arrives in North Fork with symptoms of smallpox hotel occupants are quarantined with an outlaw.

programme.title: Death Never Rides Alone
programme.desc: Gunslinger Johnny Drako rides into town and tells the bartender that he is looking for Lucas McCain. After Johnny leaves the saloon, Sweeney hurries to tell Lucas.

programme.title: I Take This Woman
programme.desc: A man arrives in North Fork, intending to marry Lou Mallory. The hotel owner looks for a way out from marrying the man to whom her dying father promised her.

programme.title: The Assailants
programme.desc: An assassination plot unfolds as four gunmen disguised as cavalrymen enter North Fork. Their target: Sen. Jim Borden. Their weapon: a Gatling gun.

programme.title: Mark's Rifle

programme.desc: Danny and Sam try to figure out the tactics of a ring of card counters; Fred Puterbaugh (Jon Lovitz) professes his love for Nessa, much to her dismay; Ed and Danny deal with an archaeologist's find near the hotel pool.

programme.title: Blood Is Thicker
programme.desc: Ed is framed for murder when enemies from his past resurface, and Danny and Mike take matters into their own hands; Sam, Mary, Nessa and Delinda select what they believe are the perfect tenants for their new investment property.

programme.title: Catch of the Day
programme.desc: Danny and Mike investigate when a truckload of lobsters is stolen en route to the hotel, while Sam travels across the country to get replacement lobsters.

programme.title: Good Run of Bad Luck
programme.desc: Danny agrees to help the wife of an ex-Marine by watching her baby while she attends an interview, but he becomes concerned when she doesn't return; Sam hosts a man who intentionally throws his money away to confound his soon-to-be ex-wife.

programme.title: Games People Play
programme.desc: Nessa questions everything Ed has told her about her father when a mysterious woman tells her that he is still alive and wishes to contact her.

programme.title: Montecito Lancers
programme.desc: Danny and Mike prepare their youth football team for the Casino League championship game and search for a missing casino employee and aspiring inventor, who is the father of one of the team members.

programme.title: Two of a Kind
programme.desc: Ed, Danny and Mike work to help Dr. Jordan Cavanaugh (Jill Hennessy) and Detective Woody Hoyt (Jerry O'Connell) as they try to solve the murder of a high-stakes gambler who appears to have had many enemies.

programme.title: Degas Away With It
programme.desc: Ed uses past connections and old-school tactics to track down the thief who stole a priceless work of art from the Montecito, leading to a tense reunion with his former partner (Alec Baldwin).

programme.title: Silver Star
programme.desc: Danny and Mike's attempt to find a missing girl leads them to a man with a criminal past; Delinda becomes enamored with the Polyphonic Spree, an unusual musical group, and its leader, Tim DeLaughter.

programme.title: My Beautiful Launderette
programme.desc: Sam learns one of her clients is laundering money for a drug cartel through the resort; Mike is convinced he has met the woman of his dreams and works hard to persuade her to date him.

programme.title: When You Got to Go, You Got to Go
programme.desc: When Ed is kidnapped, Danny and Mike franticly search the city for him, a task made more difficult by Ed refusing to let them call the police or pay the ransom.

programme.title: Sperm Whales and Spearmint Rhinos
programme.desc: A hotel guest is an apparent suicide, but further investigation by Delinda points to murder, so she sends Danny and Ed to search for the killer.

programme.title: The Lie Is Cast
programme.desc: Danny's generous act gets him into trouble with the police, leaving Ed to clean up the mess; Delinda enlists the aid of a singer to convince the chef that the restaurant should be open for lunch.

programme.title: Whale of a Time
programme.desc: A beautiful former co-worker pays a visit to Ed, but her presence puts everyone in danger; when Delinda and Nessa compete for the attentions of a high roller, their friendly competition quickly gets out of hand.

programme.title: Can You See What I See?
programme.desc: Ed decides to shake things up as the casino enters the slow season, so he orders the staff to swap jobs.

programme.title: Tainted Love
programme.desc: Sam's excitement about hosting a billionaire (Dean Cain) at the Montecito turns to dismay when her clients are caught cheating the horse-racing system, requiring Danny to come to her aid.

programme.title: To Protect and Serve Manicotti
programme.desc: When petty mobsters attempt to extort money from a local restaurant owner, Ed asks an old friend, Frank (Sylvester Stallone), to protect the owner.

programme.title: One Nation, Under Surveillance
programme.desc: When Danny's friend, an ex-Marine turned politician, gets caught in a scandal involving a runaway child, he vows to help, but quickly discovers that people are not always who they seem to be.

programme.title: Hit Me!
programme.desc: Ed relies on human ingenuity when cutting-edge technology fails to catch a thief in the act; Mary and Mike intervene when a cheating husband is caught red-handed.

programme.title: Hide and Sneak
programme.desc: Ed suspects that a Gestapo-like police unit has compromised the hotel's security system and is watching everyone, so he enlists Danny and Mike to expose the phantom mole.

programme.title: Letters, Lawyers, and Loose Women
programme.desc: Mary meets her secret admirer; when a philandering hotel guest (Dave Foley) loses his wedding ring at a local brothel, Mike agrees to help him find it.

programme.title: Magic. Carpet. Fred (Maxim Hot 100)
programme.desc: Colorful billionaire Fred Puterbaugh (Jon Lovitz) returns to the Montecito with his girlfriend (Ashanti); a beguiling magician uses his skills to help Ed catch a slippery thief.

programme.title: Centennial
programme.desc: The new owner of the Montecito plans some big changes to the property and to the personnel.

programme.title: Viva Las Vegas
programme.desc: Ed tries to get the Montecito reopened while working for a new boss and trying to lure back his former staff.

programme.title: Fake the Money and Run
programme.desc: Ed tries to keep the new boss out of the loop while he figures out who has been making counterfeit chips; Danny's accountant suggests he sell his father's house and refers him to an attractive real estate agent (Rachael Leigh Cook).

programme.title: Double Down, Triple Threat
programme.desc: When a card counter's daughter is kidnapped, Danny, Mike and Ed reunite with Dr. Cavanaugh (Jill Hennessy) to solve the high-stakes crime.

programme.title: Whatever Happened to Seymour Magoon?
programme.desc: Danny and Penny's relationship hits new levels; Jillian sprains her ankle and convinces Ed to walk the family dog at a local show; Mike must rescue Monica from her shower.

programme.title: The Big Ed De-cline
programme.desc: Ed's plan to rid himself of undue stress ends when he discovers he is a victim of identity theft.

programme.title: The Real McCoy
programme.desc: Despite Mike and Mary's warnings, Danny locates the mystery woman who appears in photos with his father and offers to pay her medical expenses.

programme.title: Everything Old Is You Again
programme.desc: Danny has a flashback to 1962 and being director of entertainment at the Jubilee Hotel and Casino.

programme.title: Bold, Beautiful and Blue
programme.desc: Danny, Monica and FBI Agent Portis review the security measures being taken to protect the Kashmir Sapphire, a priceless gemstone on loan and display at the Montecito.

programme.title: Mothwoman
programme.desc: When the Montecito hosts a comic book convention, fans mistake Monica (Lara Flynn Boyle) for the comic book heroine Mothwoman.

programme.title: For Sail by Owner
programme.desc: A stunning change of events thwarts a hostile takeover of the Montecito; a thug mugs Mike, who leaves Danny to seek his revenge.

programme.title: Down and Dirty
programme.desc: During a nationally televised poker tournament, Danny and Mike suspect someone is cheating and investigate security footage, despite protests from the show's producer.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: The Gambler
programme.desc: Sue's dependence on her hearing dog, Levi, is threatened when Levi gets lost. When Bobby goes undercover as a gambler - the team might lose more than just the next hand.

programme.title: The Lawyer
programme.desc: Sue and the FBI team capture an Al Qaeda leader planning an attack in D.C. A lawyer files a civil right violation against Jack, the terrorist could be let go.

programme.title: The Body Shop
programme.desc: The team tracks a cache of illegal visas and makes a startling discovery. Meanwhile, Sue and Lucy entertain Lucy's cousin who visits and won't leave.

programme.title: He Said, She Said
programme.desc: Sue's special skill of lipreading lands her on an FBI/DEA task force but later finds her credibility, and job, on the line.

programme.title: Secret Agent Man
programme.desc: When a mysterious photo memory stick is delivered to the FBI, Sue and the team must unravel its secrets, leading them on a twisty path to a mysterious stranger.

programme.title: Mind Games
programme.desc: Sue and the team are approached by a woman who claims she's witnessed a murder. Dimitrius is passed over for the position of supervisor and must deal with the new supervisor.

programme.title: Prodigal Father
programme.desc: Bobby is in for an emotional upheaval when his wayward father comes back into his life. Sue comes to grips with her feelings for Jack.

programme.title: Bombs Away
programme.desc: Sue's first FBI assignment involves the high stakes world of investigating an anonymous bomb threat at an oil refinery. Lucy and Sue decide to share an apartment but problems threaten their plans.

programme.title: Billy The Kid
programme.desc: When Jack's former mentor is shot, the investigation leads Jack to a disturbing discovery involving the world of illicit drug labs.

programme.title: Skin Deep
programme.desc: Sue and the team get word about an upcoming act of Eco-terrorism. When Myles discovers his cholesterol is too high, he's not the only one who suffers.

programme.title: The Holocaust Survivor
programme.desc: Sue and Jack investigate the claim of a deaf Holocaust survivor who insists she's recently seen a wanted Nazi war criminal. Myles and Bobby square off against office manager Randy.

programme.title: Pilot Pt 2
programme.desc: Sue finds some on the team are not as welcoming to a deaf woman, her unique lipreading ability and her hearing dog Levi as Agent Jack Hudson.

programme.title: The Fugitive
programme.desc: The team goes into high gear when a fugitive escapes from a prison. Sue has misgivings when invited to attend a wedding where she'll come face to face with people from high school.

programme.title: Cold Case
programme.desc: Sue tries to honor a request a killer be brought to justice. Bobby, Jack, and Myles have a competition over who can draw the highest bids as the dream dates for charity.

programme.title: Lone Wolf and Cub Part 2: Episode 1
programme.desc: The lone wolf received an assassination request to avenge a clan on the brink of being abolished. The plot thickens as they got caught in a scheme full of betrayals and deceit while being pursued relentlessly by the Yagyu clan.

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Hjerson (Dubbed) S1 E4: Episode 4
programme.desc: While heading for a peaceful swim, Hjerson finds himself in terrible danger. As the search for the beach suspect intensifies, the case also becomes increasingly personal for Hjerson.

programme.title: Pure
programme.desc: While Holly buries herself in an investigation, Duncan faces problems at home.

programme.title: Loose Ends
programme.desc: Haunted by Phil's death, Macy digs deeper into the streets, questioning informants and tracking leads as she searches for a connection between Pete and the killing.

programme.title: Day Ones
programme.desc: Tensions rise as Go-Go, one of Macy's closest allies, confronts a longtime enemy while Macy continues her relentless pursuit of those responsible for Phil's murder.

programme.title: Revenge
programme.desc: Simon Cross pulls out all the stops in an attempt to take Smith into Flatland and force Armageddon. Amy wills her way into Flatland, and discovers the horrible secret behind her relationship with Noel Jagger.

programme.title: To Be a Somebody (Part Three)
programme.desc: DCI Charlie Wise takes over the investigation. As the police close in on him, Albie reveals a few explosive tricks to carry out his revenge for Hillsborough.

programme.title: Memories of me and him
programme.desc: Soshun Kouchiyama, a tea master at Edo Castle, secretly fights injustice by beating up powerful oppressors, with the help of his friends.

programme.title: Origins II
programme.desc: After learning the truth as to where the Olivine compound was hidden, Cameron chooses to escape into exile, that is until a confrontation with General Nexxus forces Cameron to realize his true importance to the future of Humanity.

programme.title: Genesis Part II
programme.desc: After the break-in, Cameron decides that he has had enough, fortuitously leading him to discover a secret in his father's office. With a little ingenuity, Cameron and Boris begin to piece together clues to a mystery Mr. Turner left behind.

programme.title: Red Sonja
programme.desc: Red Sonja and Conan team to save a kidnapped wizard, who has the secret of youth.

programme.title: Season 1, Conan The Adventurer 120: Antidote
programme.desc: While Conan celebrates in a tavern, an unseen assassin shoots the Cimmerian with a poisoned arrow. A medicine man examines the wound and says Conan will die if someone doesnt get the antidote, which must be taken through a wall of Hissah Zul warriors.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Mathias is forced to return to the front line following an arson attack on a farmhouse which put a mother and child in danger.

programme.title: Denver McKee
programme.desc: While celebrating the return of his daughter Connie from a fancy school, former lawman U.S. Deputy Marshall Denver McKee is asked to assist in the capture of an outlaw gang.

programme.title: The Texan: S1 E20 - The Man Behind The Star
programme.desc: Longley's old friend, pretty ranch owner Martha Driscoll, negotiates a highly successful sale at the end of a cattle drive. Although her friends urge her to put her money in the bank until she's ready to board a train home, Martha refuses and ends up being robbed and murdered - but not before naming her killer - Clint Gleason, one of her trailhands.

programme.title: Next Stop the Grannies
programme.desc: The Wonderland audition for a big US TV show when some super-fans turn up and start competing with each other. Meanwhile Nate drops a bombshell which could destroy everything

programme.title: The Gunfighters
programme.desc: Tate takes on a train car full of fast guns when a simmering rancher vs. homesteader dispute escalates.

programme.title: The Beast Within
programme.desc: Malone goes after a healer that's been filled with the spirit of a demon in exchange for safe release from the village. The girls must set their differences aside and learn to trust each other.

programme.title: Show-Time
programme.desc: Star coiffeur Oliver Nienaber is in panic, as well. Anticipating that he could be the next victim, he asks Robin Van Rees, Head of Rinkhals Security, for protection. Again, we don't know yet how Nienaber is linked to the other Mauser victims and what makes him think he might be the next one.

programme.title: Riptide: S1 E10 - Long Distance Daddy
programme.desc: Two Cambodian orphans stow away on a jet to visit their American sponsor, Nick, only to be marked for death after witnessing a murder.

programme.title: Riptide: S1 E12 - Raiders Of The Lost Sub
programme.desc: Well educated, but just as goofy, Murray's sister shows up unexpectedly, and persuades the boys to look for a sunken WW2 German submarine.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Beowulf gets to work rebuilding the town's defenses--a need that becomes even greater when iron miner Greff is attacked by one of the most dangerous Mudborn creatures known to humans--a Troll.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: With Slean and his uncle Abrecan failing to warn Herot about the Wulfing Raider attack, the marauders arrive at the peripheries of an unsuspecting Herot and release their Barghest wolves to terrorize the town.

programme.title: The Heart of Lord Trash
programme.desc: Returning to London Robert's group is waylaid by Fedora and her thugs, who steal the incubus, but they are rescued by Garson. Tenebrae launches an attack on Bulstrode's headquarters, stealing the all-important Calyx, before arriving at Robert's house for a final, deadly showdown.

programme.title: Elvis Is In The Building
programme.desc: Sue and the team must infiltrate an Asian gang, requiring Bobby to go undercover as an Elvis impersonator. Sue learns Troy has an estranged brother who has a secret.

programme.title: Bat Masterson Leaves the West
programme.desc: After leaving Dodge City, Bat Masterson takes a job as manager of Denver's Palace Theatre. There he falls in love with Emma Walter, a jugging virtuoso known as the Queen of Clubs, and begins to question his life as a gunslinger.

programme.title: Lonesome Dove: Part II - On The Trail
programme.desc: McCrae and Wood's cattle drive faces deadly situations. Sheriff July Johnson heads to Texas, and former prostitute Lorena is abandoned by Jake and kidnapped by the psychotic Blue Duck.

programme.title: Our Friend, Chaos
programme.desc: An explosion rips through the downstairs of Beth-H, changing lives there forever.

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Hjerson (Dubbed) S1 E5: Episode 5
programme.desc: An unpublished novel inspires a copycat murder at a restaurant. Only five people, including the author, have read the work- so it must be an inside job. Or is it? The author contacts Hjerson and Klara to crack the case.

programme.title: Don't Take My Heart, Don't Break My Heart
programme.desc: When The Herald uncovers a sex scandal, Holly makes a powerful enemy.

programme.title: The Founders
programme.desc: As the streets become a battlefield, Macy faces impossible split-second choices that could mean life or death for herself and her allies.

programme.title: You Have to Remember
programme.desc: Unexpected alliances form while old loyalties collapse. As friends become enemies, Macy struggles to know whom she can trust amid mounting casualties.

programme.title: We Gone See
programme.desc: Caught in the crossfire of a gang war reaching its peak, Macy fights to protect her loved ones while confronting the devastating consequences of her choices.

programme.title: Aurora
programme.desc: Mitchell narrowly escapes death at the hands of a pair of vengeful archangels, one of whom he may have loved in the past, while Khan and Smith maneuver their pawns into place, in anticipation of a final showdown.

programme.title: The Juror #6 Job
programme.desc: When Parker attends jury duty in order to keep up the legitimacy of one of her aliases, she notices some strange things at the trial. It seems someone is trying to buy a favorable verdict... but not if the Leverage team can steal it first!

programme.title: Wife love, mother love, a hint of wind
programme.desc: Soshun Kouchiyama, a tea master at Edo Castle, secretly fights injustice by beating up powerful oppressors, with the help of his friends.

programme.title: Beware of Falling Rocks
programme.desc: Cameron and Boris begin to question Lucy's mysterious past. Their suspicion grows when they learn Lucy must attend an exclusive meeting at Condon Aerospace, so the two decide to sneak into the event to investigate matters further.

programme.title: Tunnels
programme.desc: Cameron wants to enter a skateboarding competition at Crater skate park but soon finds out that he is grounded and must clean his father's studio. Upon doing so, Cameron discovers a way to sneak out to the skate park after all.

programme.title: The Secret Society
programme.desc: Concerned about Cameron's behavior, the school sends him to a psychologist. When Boris visits the psychologist in Cameron's place, he reveals a little too much information, and they soon realize that this is no ordinary psychologist.

programme.title: The Cavern
programme.desc: A violent storm traps Conan in a cave with Hissah Zul's hit man.

programme.title: Season 1, Conan The Adventurer 121: Lethal Wizards
programme.desc: Three wizards, Penor, Gero and Norbu, decide to join the Cimmerian so they can be Conans advisors when he becomes the new ruler. Their plan is to worm their way into Conans confidence, then destroy him and take over as rulers.

programme.title: Redbad - The Legend Part 3
programme.desc: During a time of epic battles and bloodshed, the legend of pagan warrior king Redbad is born, but so is a new weapon against his people: Christianity.

programme.title: The Flying Club
programme.desc: The owner of Finchmere Airfield drops dead from a plane. Astonished, Barnaby and Nelson enter the world of stunt pilots and aviation heroes, and discover a web of lies and intrigue.

programme.title: The Killings of Copenhagen
programme.desc: When the boss of Calder's Biscuit Company is murdered in Copenhagen, Barnaby and Nelson join forces with two female Danish detectives, the abrasive and astute Poulsen and the charming and cool Degn, and they discover Eric Calder had more linking him to Copenhagen than just his famous Golden Clusters.

programme.title: Dance with the Dead
programme.desc: When the body of a young man is found in a WWII-era motor car full of exhaust fumes, it looks like suicide. However, Simon Bright was not alone - as he was hit on the head before he died. Where is his girlfriend, newcomer Laura Sharp? What is her hold on the people of Morton Fendle, a village still overshadowed by the gloomy spectre of the war?

programme.title: The Animal Within
programme.desc: When Faith Alexander arrives in Midsomer Deverell to meet her long-lost uncle Rex Masters, she is surprised to find that he has disappeared and that he had told everyone that she was killed in a plane crash. Then Rex's body is found in the weir, and his friends produce wills, each claiming to inherit his fortune, but what is the truth about Rex's life of mischief-making, and who wanted him dead?

programme.title: King's Crystal
programme.desc: A glassware factory in Midsomer Magna faces ruin after the death of its co-owner Alan King. His widow Hilary angers her son Ian by marrying Alan's brother Charles, and rumours begin to circulate that Charles and accountant Peter Baxter have embezzled funds. When Peter is stabbed to death with a Masonic dagger and Ian starts behaving strangely, Barnaby is called.

programme.title: The Axeman Cometh
programme.desc: When old rock band Hired Gun re-form to play a gig at the Midsomer Rocks Festival, paranoid lead singer Gary Cooper is convinced that someone is trying to scare them off and stop the reunion. Firstly, rock diva Mimi Clifton is electrocuted on stage, then drummer Nicky Harding is found dead in his swimming pool. Barnaby has to face the possibility that one of his heroes is a murderer.

programme.title: Death and Dust
programme.desc: When Dr Alan Delaney is killed by a hit-and-run driver, Barnaby realises that the real target was Delaney's senior partner, Dr James Kirkwood. Is the killer trying to prevent James from marrying beautiful divorcee Delyth Mostyn? How is the death linked to the £30,000 which is missing from the surgery account?

programme.title: A Picture of Innocence
programme.desc: When a photo of DCI Barnaby with another woman is displayed shortly before her estranged husband is murdered, he becomes a prime suspect in the crime. To make matters worse, it appears that Barnaby visited the victim on the night he died, and a glass with his fingerprints on it is found at the dead man's home. As the evidence begins to mount up against him, will Barnaby be able to clear his name?

programme.title: They Seek Him Here
programme.desc: When Nick Cheyney, director of a new film of 'The Scarlet Pimpernel' is beheaded by a guillotine on set, there is no shortage of suspects. An actor whose career he has ruined, a woman who bore his child after a drunken one-night stand, and an embittered gay, alcoholic extra all have grudges against him. Medical evidence then shows that Cheyney was drugged with morphine. Can Barnaby and Jones find the killer?

programme.title: Death in a Chocolate Box
programme.desc: When an old colleague of DCI Barnaby's is found murdered, a sex scandal at Causton police station 16 years previously comes back to haunt him. His investigation takes him to Midsomer Holm, a halfway house for ex-prisoners founded by Lord Holm, a man who also served time for the murder of his wife. As they try to find links between the suspects and a seedy group known as the Friday Nighters, another person goes missing.

programme.title: The Dogleg Murders
programme.desc: The peaceful setting of prestigious Whiteoaks Golf Club is rocked by death and controversy when a golfer is bludgeoned to death near the notorious 13th hole known as Crisp's Folly. Barnaby and Jones discover gambling is rife at the club - along with illegal money-lending and violent assault. Then, as the club considers giving ordinary villagers full membership rights, another golfer is killed.

programme.title: The Black Book
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby finds a tangled world of crime and intrigue in the art world. A recently discovered masterpiece by local artist Henry Hodgson realises an impressive price at auction just hours before its previous owner is tortured and killed. Can Barnaby and Jones prevent the body count from rising further?

programme.title: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby's secret past as a spy is revealed when a former agent is found dead after a cricket match in Midsomer Parva. While locals blame the brutal killing on the 'beast of Midsomer', Barnaby suspects otherwise. He soon finds links to a network of spies that operated in Cold War Berlin, but his investigation is obstructed at every turn.

programme.title: The Glitch
programme.desc: Science fellow George Jeffers threatens to go public with what he believes is a potentially lethal software glitch in a new air traffic control system. American software boss Clinton Finn fears he will lose millions if the truth comes out and puts pressure on the University authorities, but when village schoolteacher Emily Harte is killed by a hit-and-run driver, Barnaby wonders if Jeffers was the real target.

programme.title: Small Mercies
programme.desc: The peace of Little Worthy is shattered by a bizarre murder when a man is found stabbed and tied down like Gulliver in Lilliput in the sleepy hamlet's model village. Barnaby and Jones are called in, and they find many secrets hidden behind the traditions, tourist attractions and tearooms. Then, the killer strikes again. Can the detectives discover the truth about the residents of Little Worthy and solve the crimes?

programme.title: The Creeper
programme.desc: A burglar known as 'the Creeper' terrorises Midsomer as Barnaby and Jones investigate the murder of a dinner party guest at upper-crust Chettham Park House. The detectives discover a group of high society friends with links both to gangsters and the Chief Constable dating back to the 1960s, but do the friends also have secrets worth killing for?

programme.title: The Great and the Good
programme.desc: Schoolteacher Connie Bishop keeps waking in the night, convinced she has an intruder. Just days later a local councillor, said to be obsessed with her, is found murdered in her garden. Is Connie the innocent victim she seems? Barnaby and Jones uncover jealous rivals, ruthless social climbers and a cottage with secrets as they search for the killer in Badger's Drift.

programme.title: The Dagger Club
programme.desc: The crime drama returns for a new series. The unveiling of a newly-discovered novel by deceased Midsomer crime-writer George Summersbee at the Luxton Deeping Crime Festival is jeopardised when the manuscript is stolen and a woman is fatally electrocuted by a booby-trapped roulette wheel. Can new dad Barnaby untangle a web of jealousy and obsession to find the killer?

programme.title: Murder by Magic
programme.desc: When a pub landlady is crushed to death during a magic show in Midsomer Oaks, Barnaby and Nelson uncover conflict between the village church and ancient pagan traditions. Is famous magician Gideon Latimer to blame or is he the target?

programme.title: The Ballad of Midsomer County
programme.desc: Barnaby investigates whether a ballad made famous by a late, lamented folk singer could have been the inspiration for a murder. Did someone want to kill Toby Winning for threatening to take the Little Crosby Folk Festival away from Midsomer - or is the true motive something hidden for 20 years?

programme.title: A Vintage Murder
programme.desc: Barnaby tries to find out just who is targeting the Midsomer Vinae Winery - what does the attack have to do with the death of a child in a hit-and-run accident?

programme.title: Death in the Slow Lane
programme.desc: New DCI John Barnaby is intrigued when he learns that the remains of famous racing driver Duncan Palmer have been discovered at Darnley Park School - 40 years after he was thought to have drowned in the Lake District. During the school's classic car show, racing legend Peter Fossett is annoyed that his fellow judge is club DJ Dave 'Doggy' Day, who knows nothing about cars. Soon afterwards, Doggy is crushed to death.

programme.title: Dark Secrets
programme.desc: A social services investigator calls on elderly eccentrics William and Mary Bingham, but he is sent away rudely by their daughter Selina and her husband Eddie Stanton. Artist Maggie Viviani also had a run-in with the investigator, so when his body is found in the river, they all come under suspicion. Barnaby learns that the Binghams never recovered from losing their elder daughter and son in a drowning accident.

programme.title: Echoes of the Dead
programme.desc: When a young woman is found dressed like a bride and drowned in a bath, it triggers a spate of ghoulish wedding-themed murders in Great Worthy. The case takes Barnaby and Jones to a donkey sanctuary, a heritage steam railway and a pub run by an ex-copper and former brothel madam. Could history be repeating itself?

programme.title: The Oblong Murders
programme.desc: When a young female member of a new age cult called The Oblong Foundation goes missing, DCI John Barnaby investigates and sends DS Jones undercover at the cult's base, Malham Hall. The police learn that the hall's previous owners, the Lamberts, died in a gas explosion on board their boat. Barnaby and Jones must try to find out what really happened to the Lamberts - and whether the case has a link to the missing woman.

programme.title: The Sleeper Under the Hill
programme.desc: When a farmer is found horribly murdered in the middle of a stone circle, suspicion points at a group of druids. DCI John Barnaby and DS Jones hurry to the scene of the crime, where they are joined by new pathologist Kate Wilding on her first assignment. Druid high priest Leticia Clifford shows Barnaby that sacred ley lines run through the stone circle and later is convinced she has made an exciting discovery.

programme.title: The Night of the Stag
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones are sampling the local cider at Midsomer Abbas spring fair when the body of a missing tax inspector is found floating in the cider vat. Meanwhile, publican Samuel Quested says that he wants to restore an ancient rite called the Stag in which men go in search of women from another village in order to 'refresh the gene pool'. As Barnaby and Jones investigate the murder they uncover an array of motives.

programme.title: A Sacred Trust
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones enter the cloistered and old-fashioned world of Midsomer Priory after a nun is found strangled. Jones visits the local pub, where he learns that a woman was seen acting strangely on the day of the murder, and that teenagers in the area sneak into the priory grounds for romantic liaisons. Later, the nuns discover that a valuable silver altar set has vanished, then the chaplain is found murdered.

programme.title: Victorian Crime
programme.desc: True Crime Stories: Victorian Crime explores 19th-century Britain's dark underbelly, where morality masked murder and vice. From killers to con artists, each story reveals how class, madness, and desperation intertwined in gaslit streets. Horror born from human nature.

programme.title: Crazy Samurai: 400 vs. 1
programme.desc: A master samurai, Musashi Miyamoto, battles 400 swordsmen as they challenge his place as the samurai of the century.

programme.title: Paradox
programme.desc: A tough Hong Kong cop's teenage daughter disappears in Pattaya. He goes to Thailand to find her and must deal with corrupt cops, but an honest one helps him track down culprits involved in illegal organ trafficking.

programme.title: Legend of Gatotkaca
programme.desc: Legends collide as young Yuda wrestles to unlock newfound god-like powers, defending his world in an endless battle against ancient and powerful evils.

programme.title: The Flying Swordsman
programme.desc: After two heroes are killed during an outside attempt to steal a hidden fortune, the treasure map inexplicably disappears -- until a decade later when the original eight assassins reemerge only to be challenged by a mysterious swordsman.

programme.title: Believer
programme.desc: A low-level drug dealer joins forces with an ambitious cop to bring down a psychotic cartel kingpin.

programme.title: Big Brother
programme.desc: A former soldier is recruited for his toughest mission yet -- teaching a class of teen delinquents. As he kicks his way into their school and home lives, it becomes clear that his unconventional teaching style might be just what they need.

programme.title: God of War
programme.desc: A maverick commander and a young general join forces to battle pirates who pillage small villages in 16th-century China. The violent clash of wits and weapons will ultimately decide who rules the land.

programme.title: God of War 2
programme.desc: Benevolent healer Seon-ui discovers a divine medicinal substance called 19; she names it Il-yeo-po, and they become friends until Dong Zhuo's soldiers forcibly seize Il-yeo-po.

programme.title: The Villainess
programme.desc: Honed from childhood to be an elite assassin, Sook-hee embarks on a rampage of violence and revenge to finally earn her freedom and escape her past.
